verdict.rationale: Superhuman ships automations: custom Auto Labels, Auto Archive, and agents built via chat or a visual builder with triggers. Versioning, reviewing changes to, or rolling back automations is therefore a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents version history, change review, or rollback for any automation. Reviewing AI-generated drafts and admin governance over who can build agents are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
